Fixtures under tests/fixtures/mcphunt/ are byte slices of trace documents of

  MCPHunt Agent Traces, Hugging Face dataset lihaonan0716/mcphunt-agent-traces, revision
  c4c69322bf9ed7690f5265577365709dad5dd454, https://huggingface.co/datasets/lihaonan0716/mcphunt-agent-traces
  by Haonan Li, Tianjun Sun, Yongqing Wang and Qisheng Zhang; paper: "MCPHunt: An Evaluation Framework for
  Cross-Boundary Data Propagation in Multi-Server MCP Agents", arXiv:2604.27819, https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.27819

licensed under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International licence (CC-BY-4.0; the dataset card's `license:
cc-by-4.0` and its "License" section at that revision, README.md sha256
a8ab37b65fbbada6fb0e9c1eb7d9c501bf038a81320af5e5679cb45f745ba15b; full text in CC-BY-4.0.txt in this directory).

Modifications: each fixture file holds a selection of whole trace elements copied byte for byte from a pinned document,
inside a JSON envelope written by this project; SOURCE.json records each element's source file, offset, length and
sha256. Only elements that carry none of the study's planted canary values were chosen. Nothing else was changed.
